Elie no Atelier GB.name: Atelier Elie GB
Elie no Atelier GB.summary:
A spin-off game of the Atelier: Salburg series with 2 versions, the other being "Atelier Marie GB", that takes place after the games main character graduates from the academy and opens an alchemy shop.

Was only released in Japan.

Grandia - Parallel Trippers.name: Grandia: Parallel Trippers
Grandia - Parallel Trippers.summary: This is the story of Yuuhi's journey to return home. To do this he must obtain three keys from different areas of the world so that he can unlock a seal in the Tower of White. The evil Gurgan, who is responsible for Yuuhi's appearance in this new world, must be defeated!

Super Robot Pinball.name: Super Robot Pinball
Super Robot Pinball.summary: All of the action of the Super Robot Wars series has been condensed into pinball form.
